description_en: Configures a distributed transaction whitelist for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS SQL Server实例设置分布式事务白名单
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-dtc-security-ip-hosts-for-sql-server --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --security-ip-hosts 192.168.XX.XX,k3ecstest --white-list-group-name test1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDTCSecurityIpHostsForSQLServer

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the ECS instance and the hostname of the Windows computer. Format: `IP address,Hostname`. Separate multiple entries with semicolon (;).

For more information about how to query the computer hostname, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124321.html
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例的IP地址和Windows系统的计算机名。格式：`ip,hostname`。多个实例之间以英文分号（;）隔开。
计算机名查看方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124321.html
parameters.name: security_ip_hosts

parameters.help_en: The name of the IP address whitelist
parameters.name: white_list_group_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

DTCSetResult.description_en:
The result of the IP address whitelist configuration. Valid values:

Success
Fail
DTCSetResult.description_zh:
设置白名单的结果，取值：
Success：设置成功
Fail：设置失败
